name: express-ts-micro
description: Library management system split into six TypeScript microservices (api-gateway, auth, catalog, member, loan, reporting) for multi-repo/multi-service testing.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,auth,catalog,member,loan,reporting -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red "npm run dev --workspace=api-gateway" "npm run dev --workspace=auth-service" "npm run dev --workspace=catalog-service" "npm run dev --workspace=member-service" "npm run dev --workspace=loan-service" "npm run dev --workspace=reporting-service"
